# rsync exclusions for CODE-ONLY deployment to Hostinger.
# Anything listed here is NEVER created, updated or deleted on the server by
# automated deployments. Hostinger remains the source of truth for these.
#
# Production data (the JSON "database" and admin-created backups)
data/
# Runtime logs
logs/
# Production uploads (admin-managed media) - server is source of truth
# assets/images/menu/ and assets/images/gallery/ are 100% admin-managed.
assets/images/menu/
assets/images/gallery/
# assets/images/hero/ is SHARED: it also holds repo-controlled static hero
# assets (out-furusato.webp, sushi-hero.webp, crafted.jpg, ...) that MUST
# deploy. Only exclude admin-GENERATED upload filenames. Every admin upload
# goes through convertToWebP() (includes/image-processor.php) which always
# names files "<name>_<16-hex-random>.webp" (random_bytes(8)). Static repo
# assets never contain "_" + exactly 16 hex chars before ".webp".
# NOTE: rsync has no --delete, so server-only files (e.g. legacy slide1.jpg)
# can never be deleted by a deploy; they are simply never overwritten either
# because no tracked file shares their names.
/assets/images/hero/*_[0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f].webp
# Git + CI metadata must never land in public_html
.git/
.github/
# Secrets / server-only configuration (lives only on Hostinger)
.env
.env.*
includes/.env.php
config.local.php
# Local junk
*.bak
*.orig
Thumbs.db
.DS_Store
# Local helper docs/scripts not needed on the server
_verify_base.php
